sort_by.description:
Sort by feed businesses.

- `joined_at`: when the user joined the business.
- `web_domain`: the domain of the business.
- `title`: the title of the business profile.
- `total_members`: the total number of members in the business.

Note that when not sorting by web_domain, asc(web_domain) is used as tiebreaker.

When sorting on total_members, then businesses that have enable_members=false will
be placed last no matter the orientation.
sort_by.title: FeedBizSortBy

web_domain.description: Filters the businesses based on their web domain. This takes precedence over the `id` and `only_show_owned` fields. When specified either one or no business will be returned as this is exact match.

anyOf.description: Community handle. Only alphanumeric characters and `æ, ø, å, Æ, Ø, Å` are allowed: `a-z` `A-Z`, `0-9`, `æ, ø, å, Æ, Ø, Å`.

web_domain.title: Web Domain

only_show_owned.description: Only shows businesses you own if true, show all if false
only_show_owned.title: Only Show Owned

only_show_joined.description: Only shows businesses you have joined if true, also shows invited businesses if false
only_show_joined.title: Only Show Joined

enable_feed.description: Filter businesses based on their feed status.
enable_feed.title: Enable Feed

enable_app_user_post.description: Filter businesses based on whether app users can post.
enable_app_user_post.title: Enable App User Post

category_id.description: ID of category to fetch businesses with.
category_id.title: Category Id

embed_preview_members.description: Embeds a preview of 5 members + the total_members field.
embed_preview_members.title: Embed Preview Members

embed_app_owner.description: Embeds the owner if it is an app community.
embed_app_owner.title: Embed App Owner

embed_is_ambassador.description: Embeds if the user is an ambassador in the hub.
embed_is_ambassador.title: Embed Is Ambassador

embed_total_passes.description: Embeds the total number of non-hidden passes in the business.
embed_total_passes.title: Embed Total Passes

embed_total_posts.description: Embeds the total number of posts made by the business.
embed_total_posts.title: Embed Total Posts
